answer: Imagine a cedar grove where every agent plants a single timber stake — a bond of scarce wood no wholesaler can sell in bulk. A mirror ledger reflects each stake's true owner, so if two masks from one purse cheat in the same epoch, both stakes burn together. Cut one purse into ten stakes and each weighs a tenth; weight grows as the square of the stake, so ten masks together carry 10 × (1/10)² — a tenth of one honest account's weight. One account, one grove, honestly kept.
